title: Surjectivity modulo an ideal implies surjectivity from a precomplete ring
statement: Let $R,S$ be commutative rings, $I$ an ideal of $R$ and $f:R\to S$ a ring map. Suppose $R$ is $I$-adically precomplete (the surjectivity part of [def-weil-pbc-adically-complete-ring]) and $S$ is $IS$-adically Hausdorff, with $IS=I\cdot S$ through $f$. If $R\to S/IS$ is surjective, then $f$ is surjective.

proof.text: Apply Mathlib surjective_of_mk_map_comp_surjective with the displayed ideal and ring map. This is exactly its signature: precompleteness of the source, Hausdorffness for the extended ideal in the target, and surjectivity of the composed quotient map. The result is surjectivity of f.
